newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Excel Economico, Cigna in joint-venture.
newsitem.headline: Excel Economico, Cigna in joint-venture.

text.p: Brazilian private bank Banco Excel Economico and U.S. insurance group Cigna Corporation announced a joint venture to sell insurance plans in Brazil, Banco Excel Economico said in a statement.
The statement said the new company, to be called Excel Cigna Seguradora S.A., will have an initial capital of $20 million.
Under the terms of the deal Cigna will also acquire a 4.6 percent stake in Banco Excel Economico for $48 million, the statement said.
More details about the deal were to be made available at a news conference scheduled for later on Thursday.
